_comment: Bladesinger guild layer for 3s, migrated from the
v6 per-port format. See 3s/guilds/vikings.json for the
full section reference. Corpse/blur/plate triggers + combat
gags moved here from characters/din.json (2026-06-14) - shared
din.json is used by 3s-Din and 3k-Din, so both blade layers
carry them. Tweak for 3s vs 3k command differences as needed.

triggers._note: mw finished repairing a damaged weapon -> safe to revalrie. noparty so a party bladesinger never revalries (matches the kill-trigger policy). Resume gate then waits for 'Fully refreshed you end your revalrie.'

settings._post_kill_resume_note: After a kill the kill-trigger casts revalrie; every bot engine (Bot/Hunt/Run) then HOLDS until this text arrives or the timeout. VERIFY the exact wording with #log - if it's wrong the bot pauses the full timeout after each kill.
settings.post_kill_resume_text: Fully refreshed you end your revalrie.
settings._post_kill_resume_timeout_note: Raised 20->40 (2026-06-16): the hold now spans mw maintenance (async, several rounds on a breakable weapon) THEN revalrie, so 20s could resume mid-buff. Tune down if maintenance is always quick.
settings._blur_auto_note: Auto-blur (Toggle 'blur'). Each reset gives `max` blur charges (Din: 8) and unused charges are WASTED at refill (lost GXP + defense). Rule: while still at MAX charges, once reset% reaches the threshold, fire ONE blur; the 'disintegrates into nothingness'->blur trigger chains the rest until charges run out, finishing just before the reset refills. NOTHING HERE IS LEARNED ANY MORE - both inputs are constants in blade.py measured off the GMCP reset counter (capture 2026-08-30): BLUR_RESET_ROUNDS=1350 (45m, `reset` steps exactly 2/27% per round) and BLUR_DURATION_ROUNDS=48 (a blur spanned exactly 3.5556% of the counter, i.e. 48/1350, on both measured casts). The old _estimate_blur_reset and _blur_measure_charge learners are DELETED. Threshold = 100*(1 - (max-1)*blur_duration_secs/blur_reset_secs) - blur_auto_margin_pct; (max-1) because you cannot cast blur while one is running, so max-1 full burns must fit and the last charge only has to be CAST before the refill. For Din: 7*48=336 rounds, fires at 70%. Caveat: the reset deadline advances every 2s tick whether or not you fight, but a blur only burns in combat ROUNDS - the threshold assumes continuous combat, which is the only case that can be scheduled for. Override anytime: blur_auto_pct>0 for a fixed reset%, or blur_duration_secs to override the 96s. Shown in the blur pane as 'auto@NN%'.
